title: Leisure in Millbrook

texts.label: A
texts.heading: Millbrook Cycle Hire — Terms of Use
texts.text: Bicycles may be hired from any of the twelve docking stations across Millbrook for £1 per 30 minutes, with the first ten minutes free for annual members. A valid debit or credit card must be registered before the first hire; a temporary hold of £90 is placed on the card until the bicycle is returned undamaged. Helmets are not provided and riders are responsible for their own safety equipment. Bicycles not returned within 24 hours are treated as lost and charged the full replacement cost of £350.

texts.label: B
texts.heading: Harefield Summer Festival — Programme
texts.text: This year's Harefield Summer Festival runs from Friday 14 August to Sunday 16 August in Castle Park. Gates open at 11 a.m. each day and the main stage closes at 10.30 p.m., except on Sunday when the festival ends at 6 p.m. Weekend tickets cost £45 in advance or £55 on the gate; day tickets are available only for Friday and Saturday. Children under twelve enter free but must be accompanied by an adult. Food stalls accept card payment only; camping is not permitted.

texts.label: C
texts.heading: Oakdene Community Garden — Allotment Rules
texts.text: Allotment plots at Oakdene Community Garden are allocated on a first-come, first-served basis from a waiting list managed by the residents' association. The annual rent is £45 for a full plot or £25 for a half plot, due by 1 March each year. Plot holders must keep at least 75% of their plot cultivated; uncultivated plots may be reassigned after two written warnings. Sheds and greenhouses require prior written approval and must not exceed 2 metres in height.

texts.label: D
texts.heading: Bayview Leisure Pool — Session Times
texts.text: Bayview Leisure Pool offers public swimming daily except Wednesdays, when the pool is reserved for school lessons until 3 p.m. Lane swimming runs from 6 a.m. to 8 a.m. and again from 7 p.m. to 9 p.m.; family sessions, when inflatables are added, take place on Saturday and Sunday afternoons between 1 p.m. and 4 p.m. Admission is £5.20 for adults and £3.10 for under-sixteens, free for children under three. Swimming caps are compulsory for lane sessions but optional during family sessions.

texts.label: E
texts.heading: Thornfield Adult Learning — Evening Class Enrolment
texts.text: Thornfield Adult Learning Centre's fifty spring evening classes cover subjects from pottery to conversational Spanish, most running for eight weeks from 6.30 p.m. to 8.30 p.m. Enrolment opens online three weeks before term starts and by phone one week later for anyone without internet access. Fees range from £60 to £110 depending on materials required; concessions of 50% are available to job seekers and students with valid identification. Classes with fewer than six enrolled students by the Friday before term begins are cancelled.
